neighbours.label: ' all' in 'all around <place/person>' describing things surrounding something
fire: In spring there are wildflowers growing all around the lake.
The children noticed that birds were singing all around them.
Snow had piled up all around the cabin by morning.
There are chances to learn new things all around you.
Lanterns were hung all around the courtyard for the wedding.
Mushrooms popped up all around the old oak tree after the rain.
The fans were cheering all around us in the stadium.
Signs of autumn were visible all around the village.
quiet: In spring there are wildflowers growing near the lake.
The children noticed that birds were singing in the trees.
Snow had piled up around the cabin by morning.
There are chances to learn new things every single day.
Lanterns were hung across the courtyard for the wedding.
We all walked to the old oak tree after the rain.
The fans were cheering all night in the stadium.
All of the village could see the signs of autumn.

notes: Opposite pole (+) is ' around' in 'around the world'. Probe: 'all around the old house' 0.43, 'all around them' 0.42, but 'are all around us' 0.10 and 'all day' 0.09.
